id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4f1a: "I knew it! New races are open now. Why not enter again?

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|517b: "All I can do is pray to the gods for the prince's fortune. I hope he returns safely. Well then...

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|51f4: "But every year around the Faris Cup, a monster called the desert killer appears. I hope it doesn't this year...

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5e0d: "You will soon taste true terror beyond compare. Remember my prophecy well...
